aeronet.source: https://aeronet.gsfc.nasa.gov (Web Data Service v3, level 1.5 daily mean AOD 500 nm)
aeronet.note: Sun photometers: daytime only, so a daily mean AOD is a proxy for the air on the following night, not a night measurement. Not modelled.

globe_at_night_sqm.result: Globe at Night SQM-network data are served by the same open database (datasource 'sqm-network'); not queried because TESS-W already meets the threshold and has far more Spanish stations.
